title: UX Onboarding Flow Compiler
description: Validates onboarding flow specs: step structure, termination targets, skip options, returning user behavior, abandoned session recovery, step type validity, and contract attestation. Produces onboarding-flow-artifact.json.

pipeline.title: Parse Intent
pipeline.description: Extract onboarding-spec.json from feature brief and step definitions

pipeline.title: Structure
pipeline.description: Validate spec shape and step type validity

pipeline.title: Paths
pipeline.description: Validate termination target and skip option declarations

pipeline.title: Policy
pipeline.description: Validate returning user behavior and abandoned session recovery

gates.title: Spec Valid
gates.description: onboarding-spec.json exists with flow_id(string), steps(array), terminationTarget(string); each step has id+title+type

gates.title: Step Types Valid
gates.description: Every step.type must be one of: info, setup, permission-prompt, tutorial, verification, celebration

gates.title: Terminates to Main
gates.description: terminationTarget must be non-empty and must not point to an onboarding step id

gates.title: Skip Option
gates.description: Every step with required:false must declare skipLabel(string) and skipTarget(string)

gates.title: Returning User Bypass
gates.description: Spec must declare returningUserBehavior: skip-entirely, show-summary, start-from-incomplete, or always-show

gates.title: Abandoned Recovery
gates.description: Spec must declare abandonedBehavior: save-progress, restart, or ask-user; if save-progress, resumeKey required; escape hatch: singleSession:true

gates.title: Onboarding Flow Contract
gates.description: Version, unique step ids, terminationTarget non-empty, at least one step

contracts.description: Structural requirements for all compiled onboarding flow specs

error_codes.UOF001: onboarding-spec.json missing or invalid — flow_id, steps, terminationTarget required
error_codes.UOF002: terminationTarget is empty or circular — must point to main app, not an onboarding step
error_codes.UOF003: Optional step missing skipLabel or skipTarget
error_codes.UOF004: returningUserBehavior missing — must be skip-entirely, show-summary, start-from-incomplete, or always-show
error_codes.UOF005: abandonedBehavior missing or save-progress declared without resumeKey
error_codes.UOF006: Invalid step type — must be info, setup, permission-prompt, tutorial, verification, or celebration
error_codes.UOF007: Onboarding flow contract violation — version, unique step ids, terminationTarget, or step count invalid
